output.summary: The decline is largely explained by the forced venue move. Brightwater has 40% fewer seats and poor transit, and single-ticket sales fell 45% in the move year. Low-usage subscribers drove subscriber churn, while engaged subscribers renewed steadily at about 85%. Peer orchestras with no venue change fell a similar median 29%, so much of the drop is regional. Per-concert sales do not differ by repertoire. The cathedral downtown outsold Brightwater by about 48%. Lapsed patrons cite travel far more often than programming. Marketing effect is unmeasurable without attribution. Non-renewal now would be unsupported and would forfeit the $400k annual grant. Present a segmented analysis first and use the cathedral dates and a shuttle. The peer comparison lacks venue and segment detail.
